case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Coffee Clip Exact URL Ending
tests: Checks an exact case-sensitive URL rendered legibly on a timed end card rather than merely mentioned in the reply.

faults.what: The end-card URL is oversized and cropped at both horizontal edges, hiding the beginning and the entire June value.
The video is not silent: the supplied audio report indicates a -11.4 dB peak and speech transcribed as “茶。”

judge.summary: The vertical coffee pour and black end card are present, but the URL is severely cropped and unwanted audio violates the silence requirement.

must_haves.item: The first approximately 5 seconds show a close-up of coffee visibly pouring into a ceramic cup.
must_haves.why: The 1-second and 3-second frames show coffee pouring into a ceramic cup in close-up, followed by the end card at 5 seconds.

must_haves.item: The final approximately 3 seconds are a plain black end card.
must_haves.why: The 5-second and 7-second frames show a plain black background behind the URL.

must_haves.item: The end card reads exactly 'https://example.com/Go?ref=June', preserving uppercase G and J, the colon, slashes, question mark and equals sign.
must_haves.why: Only the cropped portion “s://example.com/Go?ref=” is readable; the full required URL is not visible.

must_haves.item: The URL is centered in white on one line, fully inside the frame and readable throughout the end card.
must_haves.why: The text is white and on one line near the vertical center, but extends beyond both sides of the frame in both end-card samples.

must_haves.item: No other written text appears anywhere in the video.
must_haves.why: No additional written text is visible in the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is silent, 9:16 and approximately 8 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The frames are 9:16 and the reported duration is 8 seconds, but the audio report confirms non-silent audio with speech.
